item.title: Australia’s Updated Policy for Responsible AI in Government
item.description: Australia is strengthening public sector AI governance, with the National Archives publishing a transparency statement and the updated APS policy reinforcing ethical, accountable and trusted AI use across government.

item.title: Vietnam: Helping Small Firms Navigate Digital Transformation
item.description: Small businesses in Vietnam are rapidly adopting digital systems primarily to meet regulatory compliance, facing high costs, technical challenges and pressure to avoid errors while striving to remain competitive.

item.title: Singapore: Driving SMEs Towards an AI-Bilingual Future
item.description: Minister of State Alvin Tan highlighted how AI is becoming essential for empowering Singapore’s SMEs, improving productivity, building an AI-bilingual workforce and ensuring an inclusive, future-ready economy.

item.title: Malaysia: Harnessing AI to Transform Public Sector Auditing
item.description: Malaysia’s National Audit Department is undertaking its largest digital transformation, leveraging advanced AI, data analytics and integrated systems to enhance audit efficiency, transparency and accountability.

item.title: Thailand: e-Testing Centre Advances AI Literacy and Lifelong Learning
item.description: Thailand is transforming its education system by launching an internationally standardised e-Testing Centre and upgrading Thai MOOCs to enable nationwide AI literacy and lifelong learning.

item.title: Australia: Interactive Digital Maps to Enhance NT Visitor Experience
item.description: The Northern Territory has introduced web-based, multilingual digital maps at key attractions to enhance visitor navigation, accessibility and overall engagement while supporting smart tourism initiatives.

item.title: The Philippines Unveils First National Digital Connectivity Plan
item.description: The Philippines officially launches its first National Digital Connectivity Plan to expand fast, secure and affordable internet nationwide, bridging the digital divide and empowering all Filipino citizens fully by 2028.

item.title: Singapore Launches National AI R&D Plan for Public Good
item.description: Singapore has unveiled a S$1 billion National AI R&D Plan to strengthen fundamental and applied AI research, foster talent development and promote innovative solutions that benefit society locally and globally.

item.title: Indonesia Strengthens Child Protection and Digital Resilience
item.description: Indonesia is proactively safeguarding children in the digital age through education, digital literacy and community collaboration to foster resilience, empathy, social harmony and responsible online behaviour.

item.title: Singapore Commits S$1 Billion to Boost National AI Research Capabilities
item.description: Singapore will invest over SG$1 billion from 2025 to 2030 under the NAIRD Plan to strengthen AI research, develop local and global talent, foster innovation and reinforce its position as a global AI hub.
